video.title: AI欧腐《被前任的黑帮哥哥缠上/Trapped By My Ex's Mafia Brother》
video.desc:
To uncover the truth behind his father's death, architect Luke spends five years posing as a mafia heir's lover. When Nicolas Moretti, the man Luke saved seven years ago, returns to claim his throne as New York's Mafia Godfather, an unexpected misunderstanding brings them together again. What begins as a dangerous game of deception and desire turns into a love worth risking everything for.
为了查清父亲的死因，建筑师 Luke 花了五年时间，假扮成一位黑帮继承人的情人。当 Nicolas Moretti——七年前被 Luke 救下的那个男人——归来登上纽约黑手党教父之位，一场意外的误会让两人再次相遇。
一场本是欺骗与欲望交织的危险游戏，渐渐变成了一段值得赌上一切的爱情。
